request.spec:
A third role, viewer, can be assigned. A viewer sees every screen and figure and can change nothing:
every form submission and every action, including changing the sheet's today, a statement, a hold
and the paste box, is refused with its usual error, writes nothing and changes nothing. A bulk
button (open, settle, reassign, grade, retire, hold, re-date, void) or a generate button (periods, a
fiscal year, quarters, plans) pressed by a viewer goes through with nothing done: its counts show 0
done and every selected item refused, and no error shows; a paste, an import, a rollover and every
other form or action by a viewer is refused with its error.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A third role, viewer, can be assigned. A viewer sees every screen and figure and can change nothing:
every form submission and every action, including changing the sheet's today, a statement, a hold
and the paste box, is refused with its usual error, writes nothing and changes nothing. A bulk
button (open, settle, reassign, grade, retire, hold, re-date, void) or a generate button (periods, a
fiscal year, quarters, plans) pressed by a viewer goes through with nothing done: its counts show 0
done and every selected item refused, and no error shows; a paste, an import, a rollover and every
other form or action by a viewer is refused with its error.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Viewer can now be assigned as a third role, and `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests in the spec.

**How it works**
- **The role:** `Role` now includes `VIEWER`. The role form offers "viewer", and an unknown role is refused with "The role must be clerk, steward or viewer". No database change was needed, because roles are already stored by name.
- **Forms and actions refused:** I added `RoleStore.refuseViewer(sheetId, user)`. It's called first thing in the validate step of all 19 changing endpoints: people, edits, claims, claim edits, status, reassign, resettle, proof, defer, today, settings, rates, roles, hold, retire, patrons, statement, quick add, paste, and period add/close/reopen. A viewer gets the usual 400 with "A viewer may change nothing", so the form or row shows its error. Nothing is stored or written to the audit file.
- **Bulk buttons go through:** `SettingStore.allows` always says no to a viewer. So bulk open and bulk settle return 200 with 0 done and every selected claim counted as refused, and no error shows. The permission setting also refuses "viewer" in its role list, so a viewer can't be granted an action that way.

**One front-end fix outside the role itself.** The first test failed at first. A viewer's refused statement left its `person-error` showing, so the next hold on the same row found two errors at once. Statement, hold and retire now share a TanStack Query mutation key per row, and each shows its error only while it is the latest action taken on that row (`useLatestPersonAction` in `features/people/people.ts`). This follows the AGENTS.md rule that an error is cleared when the next action on that row is taken.

**Not covered:** this app has no reassign, grade, retire, hold, re-date or void bulk buttons and no generate buttons (periods, fiscal year, quarters, plans). The parts of the request about those had nothing to apply to.
